scope: Canonical-blob-verified executable/test/web subset; not entire repository

checks: six original demonstrations and two explicit readings retain one reference label
blank additional category refuses without changing accepted evidence
third already-inspected reading challenges support and retires a stale export
actual raw download retains every original PNG and supplied reading without derived diagnosis
fresh narrow keyboard reopen recomputes original-row and removal witnesses
unknown categories retain a row and prevent a false unsupported-group finding
all inclusion-minimal groups remain navigable, including a pair beside a singleton

review: Independent MICROVERSE source/caller review; no remaining blocker. Root composed current server routes and inspected desktop/narrow captures.
